required_before_any_real_run: one finite root-prepared execution lock (schema jlens_pilot_execution.v1, scientific_execution_authorized true, caps equal to jlens_pilot_v1.CAPS)
the zero-fit preflight (`run_jlens_pilot_v1.py --lock <lock> --sha256 <digest>`, no --run/--worker) passing with fits=0, forwards=0, model_loads=0, tokenizer_loads=0
one independent review of the pilot glue, the lock, and the frozen threshold/tie-break behavior
the separate stage-2 parity release passing; no fidelity or J-lens claim is made before it

frozen_axes.identity_matched_control: J = I through the identical transport -> Qwen3.5 (1 + weight) final norm -> selected-unembedding code path
frozen_axes.view_reduction_prospective_pin: AB and BA raw hidden windows are pair-averaged in float64 then cast to float32 exactly as the reviewed classifier reader does; this is a prospective pin independent review must confirm or reject

cell_A_fixed_concept_raw_score.cells: retained surfaces x 3 layers x 2 conditions x 2 methods; maximum 6 x 3 x 2 x 2 = 72
cell_A_fixed_concept_raw_score.score: raw direct logit at the frozen surface token

cell_B_regularized_binary_combination.cells: 2 C values x 3 layers x 2 conditions x 2 methods = 24
cell_B_regularized_binary_combination.features: all R retained raw scores jointly; standardization on TRAIN-fold rows only
cell_B_regularized_binary_combination.refit_rule: one best-C refit per (method, condition, layer) on full TRAIN
cell_B_regularized_binary_combination.solver: existing sklearn.lbfgs LogisticRegression via grouped_driver._default_factory; never custom IRLS

threshold_plan.per_fold_selection: for held-out fold k, tau(q) is computed from fold k's TRAIN partition scores only; for the learned cell those are the fold model's in-sample TRAIN-fold logits
threshold_plan.final_refit_threshold: tau* = quantile(q*, full TRAIN OOF scores)
threshold_plan.prediction_rule: score >= tau after casting tau to float32
threshold_plan.no_eligible_threshold: report NO_ELIGIBLE_TRAIN_CANDIDATE; never tune on validation
threshold_plan.degenerate_fold: a fold whose TRAIN partition lacks either class invalidates the dependent cells whole

known_pins.verified_early: run_jlens_pilot_v1.verify_safe_interfaces(root) authenticates both cache indexes, the manifests plus blueprint and the lens header/hash with zero tensor-body, model or tokenizer reads

unresolved_pins.reason: tokenization is a stage-1 bounded job; the pilot consumes pinned (surface, token_id, single_token=true) pairs and must never load a tokenizer
provenance for the exact pinned tokenizer revision and the per-surface single-token assertion
no jlens_pilot_execution.v1 lock exists; caps, run_id, source_commit, source_files, runtime, provider_sources and inputs must be frozen and authorized
one independent review of the glue, the lock and the frozen threshold/tie-break behavior is mandatory
the separate parity release must pass before any real scoring; no fidelity claim before it

the reviewed lens runtime (.venv: torch 2.13.0+cpu, numpy 2.5.2, no scipy/scikit-learn) and the locked classifier runtime (.runtime: numpy 2.5.3, scipy 1.18.1, scikit-learn 1.9.1, no torch) are disjoint; the finite lock must authorize one reviewed environment providing both the explicit weights_only lens loader and the sklearn lbfgs backend, or a separately reviewed two-phase release
PLAN_V3 fixes the 320-case accounting but not the view reduction; the prospective pair-average convention must be confirmed or replaced under review
q*, tau* and the learned C are computed at run time from TRAIN OOF only; the frozen values are recorded in cell_results.json but a future validation release must consume them unchanged

forbidden: any model, tokenizer, forward, derivative, PCA or cone fit
any holdout or private path read; any holdout case in either cache
any vocabulary-wide scan or whole-unembedding materialization
any custom IRLS or non-sklearn learned backend
any hyperparameter search beyond the two frozen C values
any validation-driven selection, standardization, C choice or threshold

reused_helpers: jlens_io_v1 CacheIndex/lens/model pinning and selected rows
harness binary metrics, eligibility and pair-averaging
